N1.source_doc: Gecko dry adhesion (van der Waals forces)
N1.target_doc: Underwater adhesive for subsea pipeline repair

ground_truth.mechanism: NONE — dry van der Waals adhesion fails in water
ground_truth.falsifier: gecko-inspired adhesion loses >90% strength in water
ground_truth.hard_negative_reason: van der Waals forces require dry contact; water screens the interaction. The correct underwater adhesion mechanism is chemical bonding or wet adhesion, completely different physics.

ground_truth.mechanism: NONE — aerodynamic lift is irrelevant to submarine displacement
ground_truth.falsifier: wing-inspired hull shape does not improve submarine performance
ground_truth.hard_negative_reason: Submarines operate by buoyancy and displacement, not lift. The flow regime (Re, Mach) is completely different. Wing lift is irrelevant to underwater vehicle design.

ground_truth.mechanism: NONE — osmotic water storage has no electrochemical analog
ground_truth.hard_negative_reason: Osmotic water storage is a physical process; battery electrolytes require electrochemical stability. No mechanism transfers. The analogy is purely lexical (storage).

ground_truth.mechanism: NONE — structural color and electroluminescence are completely different
ground_truth.falsifier: chameleon-inspired LED shows no efficiency improvement
ground_truth.hard_negative_reason: Chameleon color is passive structural reflection; LED is active electroluminescence. No causal mechanism overlap. The analogy is superficial (both involve color).

ground_truth.mechanism: NONE — chemical luminescence and photovoltaic conversion are different physics
ground_truth.falsifier: firefly-inspired solar cell shows no efficiency improvement
ground_truth.hard_negative_reason: Bioluminescence converts chemical energy to light; solar cells convert light to electrical energy. The mechanisms are thermodynamically opposite. No causal overlap.
